source_caption_text:
21 Savage called Snoop for some costume tips 😂😂🙏

Via: @fuzzy 

21 Savage went straight to the source to get his birthday look right 😭🔥 He called Snoop Dogg to make sure his costume inspired by Snoop’s character Rodney from Baby Boy was on point for his ’90s/2000s R&B-themed party.

The 2001 movie reference was already a perfect fit for the theme, but checking the details with Snoop himself took the preparation to another level 😂👏

21 turns 34 on October 22 and clearly took the dress code seriously. How’d he do with the look? 👀🎂
